Thanks Markus —

Short answers:
1) Partner Center prefers a CSV with the following minimum columns for referral ingestion: Company name, Primary contact email, Partner contact (your partner rep), HubSpot account ID (if available), Notes. If HubSpot IDs are not available, we can match on domain + company name but that increases manual triage.

2) When an account already has a Microsoft field seller, Partner Center will first try to route to that field seller. If that seller declines or is unassigned, it will fall back to the assigned co-sell queue — which is why correct owner annotations matter. For complex cases (global enterprise with multiple MS owners), we mark the referral as "partner-qualified" and the MS field rep will engage.

3) Timeline: If you send a cleaned CSV by Thu EOD (8/6) we can ingest and kick off referrals the following week.

I've attached the Partner Center referral guide and added a link to our internal intake form. Also copying Tara who owns intake ops.

- Angela
